name: tool-output
description: Hand-authored, representative tool outputs used to measure the model-visible token cost of compaction techniques (baseline vs competitor vs UTK).
disclaimer: Cases are synthetic and self-authored — not sampled from, or submitted to, any external benchmark. The public benchmarks below are referenced only as task-category analogs so readers can anchor the kinds of tool output measured here; UTK compaction is an orthogonal context-cost layer and these numbers are not scores on those benchmarks.

related_benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 2.0
related_benchmarks.note: Containerized CLI/terminal agent tasks; the environments our shell.* cases (git, kubectl, docker, npm, terraform, rg, gh) mirror.

related_benchmarks.name: SWE-bench Verified
related_benchmarks.note: Real-repo software tasks whose test-runner output and tracebacks resemble our test/runtime-error cases.

related_benchmarks.name: τ-bench (tau-bench)
related_benchmarks.note: Tool-agent-user interaction loops that consume structured tool results like our tool.* JSON cases.

related_benchmarks.name: Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard
related_benchmarks.note: Function/tool-calling whose responses feed back into the model context that UTK compacts.
